forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01KZ23M5980FBS5HHGVTPVW1Q6
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: eb80
+project: drop-llama-agent
+title: Drop the llama executor branch from swissarmyhammer-agent
+---
+## What
+
+`crates/swissarmyhammer-agent/src/lib.rs` selects between two ACP executors,
+claude-agent and llama-agent, from the model configuration. Make Claude the
+only branch.
+
+Remove from `crates/swissarmyhammer-agent/src/lib.rs`:
+- the `use llama_agent::types::AgentAPI;` import (line 81),
+- the llama arm of the executor match near line 409 and its
+  `create_llama_agent(llama_config, mcp_config)` call (line 417),
+- `wrap_llama_into_handle` (line 543),
+- `dispatch_llama_request` (line 761) and `dispatch_llama_notification`,
+- the module doc lines that name llama-agent (lines 4 and 32).
+
+Then remove `llama-agent` from
+`crates/swissarmyhammer-agent/Cargo.toml`.
+
+A model configuration that asks for the llama executor must now fail with a
+clear error, not fall through silently. Return an error that names the
+unsupported executor.
+
+Find every remaining site with
+`grep -rn "llama" crates/swissarmyhammer-agent/`.
+
+### Subtasks
+
+- [ ] Delete the four llama functions and the import.
+- [ ] Make the executor match Claude-only, with a named error for anything else.
+- [ ] Drop the `llama-agent` dependency from `Cargo.toml`.
+- [ ] Update the module doc.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `grep -rn "llama" crates/swissarmyhammer-agent/` returns nothing.
+- [ ] `crates/swissarmyhammer-agent/Cargo.toml` does not name `llama-agent`.
+- [ ] Building an agent from a configuration whose executor is not Claude
+      returns an error whose message names the unsupported executor.
+- [ ] `cargo clippy -p swissarmyhammer-agent --all-targets -- -D warnings`
+      exits 0 with zero warnings.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Add a unit test in `crates/swissarmyhammer-agent/src/lib.rs` that builds
+      an agent from a Claude model configuration and asserts it succeeds.
+- [ ] Add a unit test that builds from a configuration naming a non-Claude
+      executor and asserts the returned error message contains that executor
+      name.
+- [ ] Run `cargo nextest run -p swissarmyhammer-agent` — all tests pass.
+- [ ] Run `cargo nextest run -E 'rdeps(swissarmyhammer-agent)'` — the reverse
+      dependencies still pass.
+
+## Workflow
+
+- Use `/tdd` — write the two executor-selection tests first.
+#cleanup
\ No newline at end of file
